40021284.author: पदार्थः
40021284.content: रावणग्रहणम् Ravana's capture, तत्तु that indeed, वायुग्रहणसन्निभम् like catching wind, ततः then, पुलस्त्यः Pulastya, शुश्राव heard, कथितम् spoken, दिवि in heaven, दैवतैः by the gods.

40021284.author: Translation
40021284.content: The capture of Ravana was as futile as trying to grasp the wind, and Pulastya heard the gods speaking of this in heaven.

40021285.author: पदार्थः
40021285.content: ततः then, पुत्रकृतस्नेहात् due to affection for his son, कम्प्यमानः trembling, महाधृतिः the greatly resolute one, माहिष्मतीपतिम् the lord of Mahishmati, द्रष्टुम् to see, आजगाम came, महानृषिः the great sage.

40021285.author: Translation
40021285.content: Then, trembling with affection for his son, the greatly resolute great sage Pulastya came to see the lord of Mahishmati.

40021286.author: पदार्थः
40021286.content: सः he, वायुमार्गम् the aerial path, आस्थाय having taken, वायुतुल्यगतिः with speed like wind, द्विजः the brahmin, पुरीम् the city, माहिष्मतीम् Mahishmati, प्राप्तः reached, मनःसम्पातविक्रमः with valor like the speed of thought.

40021286.author: Translation
40021286.content: Taking the aerial path, that brahmin, with speed like the wind and valor like the speed of thought, reached the city of Mahishmati.

40021287.author: पदार्थः
40021287.content: सः he, अमरावतिसङ्काशां resembling Amaravati, हृष्टपुष्टजनाकुलाम् filled with happy and well-nourished people, प्रविवेश entered, पुरीम् the city, ब्रह्मा Pulastya, इन्द्रस्येव like Indra's, अमरावतीम् Amaravati.

40021287.author: Translation
40021287.content: He, Pulastya, entered that city, which resembled Amaravati and was bustling with happy and well-nourished people, just as Brahma would enter Indra's Amaravati.

40021288.author: पदार्थः
40021288.content: पादचारम् on foot, इव like, आदित्यम् the sun, निष्पतन्तम् appearing, सुदुर्दशम् very difficult to behold, ततः then, ते they, प्रत्यभिज्ञाय having recognized, अर्जुनाय to Arjuna, निवेदयन् reported.

40021288.author: Translation
40021288.content: Then, seeing him appear like the sun walking on foot, very difficult to behold, they recognized him and reported his arrival to Arjuna.

40021289.author: पदार्थः
40021289.content: पुलस्त्यः Pulastya, इति thus, विज्ञाय having known, वचनात् from the words, हैहयाधिपः the lord of Haihayas, शिरसि on the head, अञ्जलिम् folded hands, आधाय having placed, प्रत्युद्गच्छत् went forward to meet, तपस्विनम् the ascetic.

40021289.author: Translation
40021289.content: The lord of Haihayas, understanding from the words that it was Pulastya, placed his folded hands on his head in reverence and went forward to meet the ascetic.

40021290.author: पदार्थः
40021290.content: पुरोहितः the priest, अस्य his, गृह्य having taken, अर्घ्यम् water for respectful reception, मधुपर्कम् madhuparka, तथैव च and similarly, पुरस्तात् in front of, प्रययौ went forth, राज्ञः of the king, शक्रस्य of Indra, इव like, बृहस्पतिः Brihaspati.

40021290.author: Translation
40021290.content: His priest, having taken the arghya and madhuparka, went forth in front of the king, just as Brihaspati goes before Indra.

40021291.author: पदार्थः
40021291.content: ततः then, तम् that, ऋषिम् sage, आयान्तम् approaching, उद्यन्तम् rising, इव like, भास्करम् the sun, अर्जुनः Arjuna, दृश्य having seen, सम्भ्रान्तः bewildered (with awe), ववन्दे bowed down, इन्द्रः Indra, इव like, ईश्वरम् the lord.

40021291.author: Translation
40021291.content: Then, Arjuna, seeing that sage approaching like the rising sun, was filled with awe and bowed down, just as Indra bows before the supreme lord.

40021292.author: पदार्थः
40021292.content: सः he, तस्य to him, मधुपर्कम् madhuparka, गाम् a cow, पाद्यम् water for washing feet, अर्घ्यम् water for respectful reception, निवेद्य having offered, च and, पुलस्त्यम् to Pulastya, आह said, राजेन्द्रः the king of kings, हर्षगद्गदया with a voice choked with joy, गिरा with words.

40021292.author: Translation
40021292.content: Having offered madhuparka, a cow, water for washing feet, and arghya to Pulastya, the king of kings then spoke to him with a voice choked with joy.

40021293.author: पदार्थः
40021293.content: अद्य today, एवम् thus, अमरावत्या with Amaravati, तुल्या equal, माहिष्मती Mahishmati, कृता made, अद्य today, अहम् I, तु indeed, द्विजेन्द्र O chief of brahmins, त्वाम् you, यस्मात् because, पश्यामि I see, दुर्दशम् difficult to see.

40021293.author: Translation
40021293.content: "Today, my city Mahishmati has been made equal to Amaravati, because today, O chief of brahmins, I am able to see you, who are so rarely seen."

40021294.author: पदार्थः
40021294.content: अद्य today, मे my, कुशलं well-being, देव O god, अद्य today, मे my, कुशलं well-being, व्रतम् vow, अद्य today, मे my, सफलं fruitful, जन्म birth, अद्य today, मे my, सफलं fruitful, तपः penance, यस्मात् because, देवगणैः by hosts of gods, वन्द्यौ worthy of veneration, वन्दे I bow, अहं I, चरणौ feet, तव your.

40021294.author: Translation
40021294.content: O revered one, today is auspicious for me, my vow is fulfilled, my life is fruitful, and my penance is successful, because I bow to your feet, which are worshipped even by the hosts of gods.

40021295.author: पदार्थः
40021295.content: इदं this, राज्यम् kingdom, इमे these, पुत्राः sons, इमे these, दाराः wives, इमे these, वयम् we, ब्रह्मन् O Brahmana, किं what, कुर्मि I do, किं what, कार्यम् work, आज्ञापयतु please command, नः us, भवान् your esteemed self.

40021295.author: Translation
40021295.content: O Brahmana, this kingdom, these sons, these wives, and we ourselves are at your disposal; please command us what we should do or what task is to be performed.

40021296.author: पदार्थः
40021296.content: तं him, धर्मे regarding dharma, अग्निषु regarding sacred fires, पुत्रेषु regarding sons, शिवं welfare, पृष्ट्वा having asked, च and, पार्थिवम् the king, पुलस्त्यः Pulastya, उवाच spoke, राजानं to the king, हैहयानां of the Haihayas, तथा also, अर्जुनम् Arjuna.

40021296.author: Translation
40021296.content: Having inquired about the welfare of that king, Kartavirya Arjuna, regarding his dharma, sacred fires, and sons, sage Pulastya then spoke to him.

40021297.author: पदार्थः
40021297.content: नरेन्द्र O king, अम्बुजपत्राक्ष lotus-petal-eyed, पूर्णचन्द्रनिभानन one whose face resembles the full moon, अतुलं incomparable, ते your, बलं strength, येन by which, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, त्वया by you, जितः conquered.

40021297.author: Translation
40021297.content: O king, whose eyes are like lotus petals and whose face resembles the full moon, your strength is incomparable, by which Dashagriva (Ravana) was conquered by you.

40021298.author: पदार्थः
40021298.content: भयात् from fear, यस्य whose, उपतिष्ठेतां stand motionless, निष्पन्दौ motionless, सागरानिलौ the ocean and the wind, सः that, अयं this, मृधे in battle, त्वया by you, बद्धः bound, पौत्रः grandson, मे my, रणदुर्जयः unconquerable in battle.

40021298.author: Translation
40021298.content: That grandson of mine, who is unconquerable in battle and from fear of whom the ocean and the wind stand motionless, has been bound by you in combat.

40021299.author: पदार्थः
40021299.content: पुत्रकस्य of my son, यशः fame, पीतम् consumed, नाम reputation, विश्रावितम् made known, त्वया by you, मद्वाक्यात् by my words, याच्यमानः being requested, अद्य today, मुञ्च release, वत्सम् the child, दशाननम् Dashanana.

40021299.author: Translation
40021299.content: You have diminished my son's fame and spread your own reputation, so now, at my request, release this child Dashanana.

40021300.author: पदार्थः
40021300.content: पुलस्त्याज्ञाम् Pulastya's command, प्रगृह्य having accepted, ऊचे spoke, न not, किञ्चन anything, वचः word, अर्जुनः Arjuna, मुमोच released, वै indeed, पार्थिवेन्द्रः the king of kings, राक्षसेन्द्रम् the lord of Rakshasas, प्रहृष्टवत् joyfully.

40021300.author: Translation
40021300.content: Having accepted Pulastya's command, Arjuna spoke not a word, and indeed, the king of kings joyfully released the lord of Rakshasas.

40021301.author: पदार्थः
40021301.content: सः he, तम् him, प्रमुच्य having released, त्रिदशारिम् the enemy of the gods, अर्जुनः Arjuna, प्रपूज्य having honored, दिव्याभरणस्रगम्बरैः with divine ornaments, garlands, and garments, अहिंसकम् non-violent, सख्यम् friendship, उपेत्य having obtained, साग्निकम् witnessed by fire, प्रणम्य having bowed down, तम् to him, ब्रह्मसुतम् the son of Brahma, गृहम् home, ययौ went.

40021301.author: Translation
40021301.content: Having released Ravana, the enemy of the gods, Arjuna honored him with divine ornaments, garlands, and garments, then, having established a non-violent friendship witnessed by fire and bowed to Pulastya, the son of Brahma, he returned home.

40021302.author: पदार्थः
40021302.content: पुलस्त्येनापि by Pulastya also, सन्त्यक्तः released, राक्षसेन्द्रः the lord of Rakshasas, प्रतापवान् mighty, परिष्वक्तः embraced, कृतातिथ्यः having been offered hospitality, लज्जमानः feeling ashamed, विनिर्जितः defeated.

40021302.author: Translation
40021302.content: The mighty lord of Rakshasas, Ravana, though released by Pulastya, embraced, and offered hospitality, felt ashamed, having been defeated.

40021303.author: पदार्थः
40021303.content: पितामहसुतः the son of the grandfather, च and, अपि also, पुलस्त्यः Pulastya, मुनिपुङ्गवः the foremost among sages, मोचयित्वा having released, दशग्रीवम् Dashagriva, ब्रह्मलोकम् to the world of Brahma, जगाम went, ह indeed.

40021303.author: Translation
40021303.content: And also, Pulastya, the son of Brahma and the foremost among sages, having released Dashagriva, indeed went to the world of Brahma.

40021304.author: पदार्थः
40021304.content: एवं thus, सः he, रावणः Ravana, प्राप्तः experienced, कार्तवीर्यात् from Kartavirya, प्रधर्षणम् humiliation, पुलस्त्यवचनात् by the words of Pulastya, च and, अपि also, पुनः again, मुक्तः released, महाबलः the mighty one.

40021304.author: Translation
40021304.content: Thus, the mighty Ravana, having experienced humiliation at the hands of Kartavirya, was again released due to the intervention and words of Pulastya.

40021305.author: पदार्थः
40021305.content: एवं thus, बलिभ्यः than the strong, बलिनः stronger ones, सन्ति exist, राघवनन्दन O delight of the Raghus, न not, अवज्ञा disrespect, हि indeed, परे towards others, कार्या should be done, यः who, इच्छेत् desires, प्रियम् good, आत्मनः of oneself.

40021305.author: Translation
40021305.content: Thus, O delight of the Raghus, there are indeed stronger individuals than the strong, and one who desires their own welfare should never show disrespect towards others.

40021306.author: पदार्थः
40021306.content: ततः then, सः he, राजा king, पिशिताशनानाम् of the flesh-eaters, सहस्रबाहोः from Sahasrabahu, उपलभ्य having obtained, मैत्रीम् friendship, पुनः again, नृपाणाम् of kings, कदनम् slaughter, चकार caused, चचार roamed, सर्वाम् all, पृथिवीम् earth, च and, दर्पात् out of arrogance.

40021306.author: Translation
40021306.content: Then, that king of the flesh-eaters, having obtained a truce from Sahasrabahu, again caused the slaughter of kings and roamed all over the earth with arrogance. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे त्रयस्त्रिंशः सर्गः ।। 33 ।। Thus ends the thirty-third sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
